criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
criteria.evidence: Official Purdue BuildingShapes FID 83 identifies BLDG_ABBR HAWK / George A. Hawkins Hall. Source ring transformed using documented local campus approximation; 65 cleaned vertices compared directly to the lower shell, maximum nearest-vertex delta 0.0000 m (mean 0.0000 m).

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
criteria.evidence: GIS footprint has the same campus placement and directional outline; the asset's direct evaluated bounds are X 150.431–201.053, Y -557.261–-461.206 m. GIS is in EPSG:4326 and conversion is an approximate local transform, not a survey; aerial overlay is supportive but imagery georeferencing/date are not stated.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.evidence: Purdue OEP snapshot supports 13 floors on east wing and 10 on west/connector. GIS extrusion field is 140, modeled as feet = 42.672 m, but metadata does not confirm units/meaning; GIS NUM_LEVELS=15 conflicts with OEP floor counts. The 10-floor mass height is estimated by proportional division (10/13), not measured. Flat roof is consistent with aerial and exterior photo.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
criteria.evidence: Saved Purdue exterior photo supports red/orange brick, repeated window bands, light trim, and flat roof. Render includes these visual elements and split-height wings. Exact window spacing, central entry station/canopy, and upper-wing boundary are not dimensioned; entrance placement is explicitly inferred.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.evidence: Directly opened saved .blend in Blender; expected scene/collection present, 7 collection objects (7 meshes), evaluated bounds Z 0.000–42.737 m; no modifiers on exported objects; file images are project-relative and resolve: True. Raw GIS, OEP, housing pages, exterior photo, aerial, render, and validation are saved. No single machine-readable evidence_record.json; source and uncertainty details are instead in audit README and validation JSON.

recorded_validation.scene_height_note: 140 ft maximum from official GIS attribute; east/west floor counts per 2026 OEP. West/connector height is an estimate at 10/13 of 140 ft.

findings: Keep the 140 ft height interpretation explicitly uncertain until a source confirms the GIS extrusion units or a dimensioned elevation is found.
GIS NUM_LEVELS=15 and OEP floor counts (13 east / 10 west) conflict; preserve both and label the west/connector height as estimated.
Upper east-wing split and central entry location are approximate; the photo is not a dimensioned or georeferenced elevation.
The 0.29 m overall plan-bound expansion relative to the GIS structural outline is attributable to facade/trim projections; evaluate structural base separately from the total render bounds.
